verdict.rationale: A hardware security key stores credentials, including passkeys, so a buyer could fairly ask whether they can wipe or delete what it holds. The axis therefore applies. The evidence documents only adjacent account and pairing controls: removing the key from an account, unpairing Bluetooth devices, and a reset that leaves the key still registered. None of these is a documented data retention or deletion control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
